marks.gloss_en: דאמר ריש לקיש: אין הקב"ה מכה את ישראל אלא אם כן בורא להם רפואה תחילה
Resh Lakish: the Holy One strikes Israel only if He first creates their cure, as said 'when I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered' (Hos 7:1)
והיינו דתנן: באחד באדר משמיעין על השקלים -- the shekels precede Haman's (a mishna, not a baraita; no support kind names והיינו דתנן)
the mishna: on the first of Adar they announce the shekels and the mixed species
וכי אחי אביה הוא? והלא בן אחות אביה הוא! -- Jacob was her father's sister's son
the verse: 'and Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother' (Gen 29:12) -- object of the difficulty: was he not her father's sister's son?
אלא, אמר לה ... אחיו אנא ברמאות (= p_achiv_beramaut)
[R' Elazar:] 'her father's brother' means: I am his brother in trickery
מכלל דעד השתא לאו לאה היא? -- was she not Leah until the morning?
אלא: מתוך סימנין שמסרה רחל ללאה לא הוה ידע עד השתא (= p_simanim_lo_yada)
when night came she said: now my sister will be shamed -- and she gave them to her
R' Elazar on 'He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous' (Job 36:7): as reward for Rachel's modesty Saul descended from her, and as reward for Saul's modesty Esther descended from him
Rachel: I have a sister older than me and he will not marry me off before her; [Jacob] gave her signs
and Saul's modesty? as written 'but of the matter of the kingdom he did not tell him' (1 Sam 10:16); he merited that Esther descended from him
'and Esther did Mordechai's word' (Esth 2:20): R' Yirmeya -- she would show menstrual blood to the Sages
R' Chiya bar Abba in R' Yochanan's name: the Holy One angered a master at his servants to do a righteous man's will -- Joseph, as said 'and there was with us a Hebrew youth' (Gen 41:12)
[and] servants at their masters to do a miracle for a righteous man -- Mordechai, as written 'and the matter became known to Mordechai' (Esth 2:22)
R' Yochanan: Bigtan and Teresh were two Tarsians speaking Tarsian; they did not know that Mordechai sat in the Chamber of Hewn Stone and knew seventy languages
one to the other: are not my watch and yours different? -- I will keep my watch and yours
'after these things' (Esth 3:1) -- after what? Rava: after the Holy One created the cure for the blow
'to lay hands on Mordechai alone' (Esth 3:6): Rava -- first Mordechai alone, then Mordechai's people, the Rabbis, and finally all the Jews
a tanna: when the lot fell on Adar he rejoiced greatly: the lot fell on the month Moses died -- not knowing that on the seventh of Adar he died and on the seventh of Adar he was born
'there is one people' (Esth 3:8): Rava -- there is none who knew slander like Haman
Ahasuerus: there are Rabbis among them. Haman: they are one people [they will be judged together]

Haman: lest you say I make a bald patch in your kingdom -- they are scattered among the peoples; lest you say there is profit from them -- 'dispersed' (meforad), like a mule (pereda) that bears no fruit; lest you say there is a province of them -- 'in all the provinces of your kingdom'

Haman: 'their laws differ' -- they do not eat of ours or marry with us; 'they do not keep the king's laws' -- they idle away the year with 'today is Shabbat, today is Passover'; 'it does not profit the king' -- they eat, drink and scorn the king; a fly in one's cup he tosses out and drinks, but if my lord the king touches his cup, he dashes it to the ground and does not drink
Resh Lakish: it was revealed before Him who spoke and the world came to be that Haman would weigh shekels against Israel; therefore He put their shekels before his
